messages:
sophie_support: hey—we started getting customer reports of TLS handshake failures right after the scheduled cert rotation at ~02:00 UTC. They see immediate connection errors to the private API gateway (502 / TLS handshake fail). Can we confirm a rotation problem?

maria_support: seeing spikes in 502s from gateway-priv-west. Tickets coming in. Any quick checks we can run before paging infra?

rajeev_sre: i'm on it. pulling gateway logs now. looks like a bunch of 'client handshake failed: certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate' from the HAProxy frontends.

rajeev_sre: repro from our side (internal probe):
```
openssl s_client -connect api-private.example.net:443 -servername api-private.example.net -showcerts
CONNECTED(00000003)
depth=0 CN = api-private.example.net
verify error:num=20:unable to get local issuer certificate
---
Certificate chain
 0 s:CN = api-private.example.net
   i:C = US, O = Acme CA, CN = Acme Intermediate CA
```

maria_support: that error usually means the server bundle didn't include the intermediate. was the bundle truncated during upload?

lin_dev: rotator logs show successful upload at 02:00:12, but the uploaded object size is 1.6k while previous bundles are ~3.4k. suspicious. rotator-bot: show last upload metadata please.

rotator-bot: last_upload: 2026-03-17T02:00:12Z, object_key: certs/tenant-42/api-private/20260317.pem, size_bytes: 1624, md5: d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e

lin_dev: that md5 looks like a zero-content pattern. downloading object now...

rajeev_sre: while you fetch, note this is only impacting certain backends. some gateways served OK, others returned the truncated chain. suggests a partial propagation / some nodes picked the good bundle, others the bad one.

lin_dev: downloaded file is indeed missing the intermediate. looks like the rotator's atomic replace path had a bug: it uploaded the leaf-only file to the staging key and swapped keys before compose finished. S3 eventual consistency + our compose flow = transient truncated bundle live for ~7m.

sophie_support: customers affected are on private VPCs with strict client trust stores. they reject chains without the intermediate. customer-facing tickets expect a root cause and ETA for fix.

rajeev_sre: mitigation for now: re-upload a correct concatenated bundle to the same object key, then force HAProxy reload on the affected nodes to pick up the fixed cert immediately. i can roll that out in the next 10m.

lin_dev: preparing corrected bundle and will push to object key now. also adding immediate validation step in rotator to verify chain length >= 2 and that issuer of leaf matches next cert subject.

rotator-bot: upload completed: certs/tenant-42/api-private/20260317.pem (size_bytes: 3428)

rajeev_sre: reloaded haproxy on gateway-priv-west-1a and -1b. monitoring.

maria_support: customer reports connections coming back for some of them. :thumbsup: please note which customers still fail so support can follow up.

sophie_support: two remaining tenants reported intermittent failures, i'll paste ticket IDs in the ticket thread.

rajeev_sre: logs now show handshake success on previously failing nodes. i still see a handful of older TLS sessions that error during renegotiation; restarting the proxy instance clears those. queued restart for ones with >1% error rate.

lin_dev: root cause summary for the report: rotator race condition + object swap path allowed a truncated leaf-only PEM to be visible briefly. some gateway instances picked that truncated bundle causing missing intermediate -> client verify failure for strict trust stores. not an OCSP issue.

maria_support: action items:
- lin_dev: immediate patch to rotator to validate chains before swap + integration test (ETA 24h)
- lin_dev/rajeev_sre: add alert on "certificate_chain_length < 2" and bundle size deviation (ETA 48h)
- rajeev_sre: change rollout to use a 'deploy-to-canary-nodes then measure' pattern to avoid wide blast radius (ETA 72h)
- support: follow up with affected customers and confirm resolution (sophie)

sophie_support: i'll update customers and close tickets once they ack.

lin_dev: quick patch already pushed to rotator dev branch to add chain validation. will schedule prod deploy ASAP. also adding an S3 atomic-put change to avoid intermediate visibility.

rajeev_sre: postmortem note: we should consider serving chain checks at gateway startup too (fail hard if chain invalid) to avoid serving truncated bundles. adding to infra backlog.

maria_support: thanks all. great coordination. leaving thread open for follow-ups and the patch release note.

sophie_support: confirmed with tenant-42: all green after reupload + proxy reload. closing from support side after we publish RCA. :white_check_mark:
